observations.description: One tall, broad, upright cylindrical body at the left; curved top and bottom rims give it volume. Its lower end includes a darker central connector assembly and a narrow projecting terminal. Printed markings occupy the front of the body.
A second, shorter upright cylindrical body at the lower right, with a rounded upper rim, darker lower rim and central stepped terminal projecting downward. Its front also carries printed markings.
sourceFacts: shorter and narrower than left component

observations.description: A third slender cylindrical body occupies the upper right and slopes down toward the right. It has a short bent lead extending from the upper-left end, a dark end face there, and a long curved lead leaving the lower-right end and bending downward. Printed markings run along the body.

The source is monochrome and uses Cyrillic manufacturer/model/specification printing, including capacitance/voltage-looking number lines. Some small characters are indistinct at this single permitted open; exact numeric transcription is not asserted. There is no circuit wiring between the components, no cutaway, no explicit internal foil/oxide/electrolyte layers, no explanatory leader lines, and no external figure labels visible.
